item: DIAG-B2-OF-01 NUMERICAL_INTERPOLATION_SENSITIVITY diagnostic (SC-WP-10 F7 / F8 / UQ)
method: NEW_DIAGNOSTIC_ACCEPTANCE (new behaviour with no Python reference; analytic and registered-evidence test cases; no synthetic Python reference is created, RM-R26)
registration_statement: Committed alone, before any code of the diagnostic (its Rust module and the additive abep-intake accessors it needs) exists. Never edited after commit: a changed definition, case, expectation or decision rule is acceptance_prereg_v2, and no case is removed or weakened after a failure.

governing_records.sections: sec. 6 (INTAKE INTERPOLANT - B2-OF-01, binding word for word), sec. 12 (LANE DESIGN/UQ - SC-WP-10), sec. 21 (empty robust set)

governing_records.role: the B2 lane's survey of the known degenerate internal faces (affected_faces, recorded maximum spreads and their points, default points) and its rounding threshold RTOL = 1e-12
finding B2-OF-01 (a property of the frozen Python reference; the admitted Rust port replicates scipy's simplex walk)

owner_ruling_a9_31_sec_6_verbatim: Do NOT regenerate or smooth intake_surface_v1.
Do NOT change the admitted Rust interpolation merely to make the surface appear nicer.
For SC-WP-10 F7/F8 / UQ: add a separate numerical-sensitivity diagnostic for a candidate lying exactly on one of the known degenerate internal faces.
Do not use an arbitrary epsilon.
Determine an exact-face condition from the canonical frozen grid coordinates.

For an exact-face candidate: retain the authoritative frozen result; additionally compute/report the adjacent-simplex ambiguity envelope where feasible; classify that envelope as NUMERICAL_INTERPOLATION_SENSITIVITY.
Never retune the optimizer to hide it.
Do not mark a candidate robust merely because one triangulation branch is favourable.
No effect on the already-admitted default points, whose recorded spreads are at floating-noise level.
unchanged: the frozen intake_surface_v1 data, the captured reference triangulation / search structures and the admitted abep-intake interpolation (authoritative value = the simplex the replicated scipy walk selects) are not modified; the diagnostic only reads them. The admitted IntakeSurface evaluation, every admitted parity case and the default points stay bit-identical.

definitions.canonical_grid: per scattering table s in {maxwell, cll} and axis a in (L_over_d, phi, alpha, theta_deg): G_s,a = the sorted distinct values of that column over the frozen CSV rows of table s (read through the sha256-verified abep-intake reader). Cross-check (fail closed, MODEL_ERROR): G_s,a equals intake_surface_v1.json grid[a] numerically for both tables. Today: L_over_d {3, 5, 10, 20}, phi {0.8, 0.9}, alpha {0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1}, theta_deg {0, 2, 5}.
definitions.interior_grid_values: I_s,a = G_s,a without its minimum and maximum. Today: L_over_d {5, 10}, alpha {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}, theta_deg {2}; phi has none.
definitions.known_degenerate_faces: K = the survey's affected_faces ('L_over_d = 10', 'L_over_d = 5', 'alpha = 0.2', 'alpha = 0.5', 'alpha = 0.8', 'theta_deg = 2'), parsed as (axis, value). Cross-check (fail closed, MODEL_ERROR): K equals the set {(a, v): v in I_s,a} for both tables (the survey drew its faces from the same grid).
definitions.exact_face_condition: a candidate surface point p = (L_over_d, phi, alpha, theta_deg) lies EXACTLY on a known degenerate face iff every coordinate is finite and inside the closed table range and there is an axis a with p_a == v for some (a, v) in K, where == is IEEE-754 equality of the f64 values (no tolerance of any kind; the candidate coordinates and the canonical grid values are both parsed from their decimal text with correct rounding). A point 1 ulp away from a face is NOT on it.
definitions.face_geometry: n_on_grid = number of axes a with p_a in G_s,a (exact equality); free_dims = 4 - n_on_grid. Classes: OUT_OF_DOMAIN (non-finite or outside the closed range); NOT_ON_KNOWN_FACE (the exact-face condition is false); GRID_NODE (on a known face, free_dims = 0); GRID_EDGE (on a known face, free_dims = 1); FACE_INTERIOR (on a known face, free_dims >= 2).
definitions.analytic_basis: Qhull triangulates every degenerate tensor-grid cell using only its corner points, so each simplex lies in one cell and, inside one cell, the piecewise-linear interpolant is single-valued. On a face shared by two (or more) cells the value can depend on which cell's simplex is used. On a grid node every containing simplex returns the node value; on a grid edge every cell triangulation restricted to the edge is the edge itself, so every containing simplex returns the same linear interpolant of the two end nodes. Hence GRID_NODE and GRID_EDGE points are single-valued up to floating rounding, and only FACE_INTERIOR points can carry a non-conforming ambiguity (the survey's non-conforming points are all FACE_INTERIOR; its default points are GRID_EDGE or FACE_INTERIOR and at rounding level).
definitions.authoritative_value: the species-row values (eta_c, C_D, CR_passive, K_back, mass_kg per species) interpolated in the simplex the admitted abep-intake replication of scipy's walk selects; unchanged and always reported first.
definitions.ambiguity_envelope: over every non-degenerate simplex of the captured reference triangulation of table s whose five barycentric coordinates of the rescaled point (scipy _barycentric_coordinates) all lie in [-eps, 1 + eps], with eps = 100 * DBL_EPSILON = the reference's own find-simplex tolerance (scipy FIND_SIMPLEX_EPS, already registered in abep-intake and used by the B2 survey; not a parameter of this diagnostic): per species and field, the interpolated value in each such simplex, their minimum, maximum and the relative spread (max - min) / |mean| (the survey's definition). Feasible = the point is in domain and at least one containing simplex exists; otherwise the envelope is NOT_EVALUATED with the reason (OUT_OF_DOMAIN or MODEL_ERROR).
definitions.sensitivity_class: ROUNDING_LEVEL when every relative spread is <= 1e-12 (the survey's registered rounding threshold RTOL of finding B2-OF-01, reused, not new); NON_CONFORMING otherwise. Reported as status NUMERICAL_INTERPOLATION_SENSITIVITY with the class, the envelope, the authoritative value, the faces hit and free_dims.
definitions.f7_f8_application: for every F8 survivor and every F7 upstream Pareto member of the nominal context, the surface points it would touch are (L_over_d, phi, alpha of the scenario, theta_deg = 0) per surface scenario and (..., theta_deg = 5) for the pointing node, in the scenario's scattering table. Each is classified; the record also states interpolant_used_by_chain, which is false for the active F7 / F8 chain: it consumes the committed F1 IF-A1 records and species table (intake_synthesis uses the frozen surface only at exact grid nodes of its build state and direct TPMC elsewhere) and never calls the interpolant.

rules.R-01: the authoritative frozen result is retained and is never replaced by an envelope value, a mean or a favourable branch
rules.R-02: the diagnostic is a separate record; F7 / F8 outputs (contexts, Pareto sets, survivors, scenario robustness, Monte Carlo records, robust Pareto set) are bit-identical with and without it
rules.R-03: a candidate is never marked robust, feasible or preferred because one triangulation branch is favourable; the diagnostic carries no robustness, feasibility, PASS or selection field
rules.R-04: no epsilon is introduced for the exact-face condition; the only tolerances used are the reference's own find-simplex eps (containment) and the survey's registered rounding threshold (classification of a measured spread)
rules.R-05: the frozen surface, the captured triangulation and the admitted interpolation are read-only; the only abep-intake change is an additive public accessor (authoritative species rows and the per-simplex rows of the containing simplices), justified by this record

acceptance_cases.expected: face_geometry GRID_NODE, faces_hit [L_over_d = 5, alpha = 0.5, theta_deg = 2], free_dims 0, sensitivity_class ROUNDING_LEVEL (every spread <= 1e-12), and every envelope value and the authoritative value equal the CSV node row of that point within 1e-12 relative

face_geometry GRID_EDGE for the four points with one off-grid coordinate and FACE_INTERIOR for (10, 0.85, 0.95, 0); every envelope spread <= 1e-12 (ROUNDING_LEVEL), consistent with the survey's recorded floating-noise spreads (owner: no effect on the default points)

face_geometry FACE_INTERIOR, sensitivity_class NON_CONFORMING, |spread_rust - survey_spread| <= 1e-12 for the named field / species (the survey evaluated the same captured simplices with numpy dot products, so only rounding may differ), and the authoritative value lies inside [min, max] of the envelope

acceptance_cases.point: the AT-03 CR_passive point with theta_deg = the next f64 above 2.0
acceptance_cases.expected: face_geometry NOT_ON_KNOWN_FACE and diagnostic NOT_APPLICABLE (no epsilon), the authoritative value is still returned

NOT_ON_KNOWN_FACE (the third is a domain corner: every coordinate on an outer grid value, none interior), diagnostic NOT_APPLICABLE; the containing-simplex values there are single-valued (spread <= 1e-12), confirming that only interior faces carry the ambiguity
face_geometry OUT_OF_DOMAIN, envelope NOT_EVALUATED (status OUT_OF_DOMAIN), no value
canonical grid equals intake_surface_v1.json grid for both tables; K equals the interior grid values; a tampered survey face list or grid is refused (MODEL_ERROR)

every surface point of the active F7 / F8 candidates (L_over_d in {3, 5, 10, 20}, phi in {0.8, 0.9}, alpha of the 10 scenarios, theta_deg in {0, 5}) is a GRID_NODE or NOT_ON_KNOWN_FACE point, none is FACE_INTERIOR, every envelope is ROUNDING_LEVEL, and interpolant_used_by_chain is false. If this prediction fails it is reported, never hidden
the F8 robust pipeline outputs (survivors, scenario robustness, Monte Carlo records, robust Pareto set) of one registered sub-grid are identical with the diagnostic computed and not computed
two evaluations of every case give bit-identical records

decision_rules.verdict: ACCEPTED iff every acceptance case passes in the Rust test suite (cargo test --workspace --locked, no ignored test) and in the one scored execution recorded in acceptance_report_v1.json; otherwise NOT_ACCEPTED (the report is committed either way; a fix is acceptance_prereg_v2)
decision_rules.meaning: software verification of a numerical diagnostic, not physics validation, not a change of the frozen surface and not a gate PASS

outputs.rust: abep_uq::interp_sensitivity (classification, envelope, F7 / F8 application) and the additive abep_intake::surface accessors; tests in crates/abep-uq

what_this_is_not: not a regeneration, smoothing or replacement of intake_surface_v1 (owner A9.31 sec. 6)
not a change of the admitted abep-intake interpolation or of any admitted parity result
not an input to robustness, feasibility or ranking: the authoritative value governs, the envelope is reported beside it
not physics evidence about the intake
